r1.description: Name of the first robot involved in the distance constraint

r2.description: Name of the second robot involved in the distance constraint

automaticMonitor.description: If true automatically display distance constraint monitors as constraints get activated. Otherwise those monitors are managed manually

useExtra.description: If true and r1Index == r2Index, add the extra distance limits set (RobotModule::extraDistanceLimits)

useEssential.description: If true and r1Index == r2Index, add the essential distance limits set (RobotModule::essentialDistanceLimits)

distances.description: List of distance limits in the constraint
